blocks.text: National Integration Camp at Kerala

Balanki Karthikeya of 3rd year ECE branch has been selected for the National Integration Camp held at Mahatma Gandhi University, Kottayam, Kerala from 17th to 23rd February, 2026.On this proud occasion, the Principal Prof. N. Ramana, NSS Program Co-ordinator Prof. Esam Narayana, Program Officers Dr. D. Sailaja, and M.. Soujanya, teaching and Non-teaching staff congratulated and appreciated him for his achievement.
